name: Ochin

tagline.en: In search of the unknown bird

promise: We never pretend to catch the bird: every story shows where an open question flies, who chased it before, and what is still unknown. Wonder, not trivia. For every age.

shankha.means: the conch-shell bangle; the page itself

sindur.means: vermilion; a mark, never a field

paper.means: older paper: boxes, mounts, quiet pages

holud.means: turmeric: light, lamps, the sun, first things

neel.means: indigo: night, space, depth, history's weight

kolapata.means: banana leaf: life, plants, growth, the body

padma.means: the river: water, weather, travel, machines

shapla.means: water lily: people, feeling, art, the self

mati.means: terracotta: earth, craft, the past, home

ratios.inside: paper about half, ink a fifth, the section's two colours a sixth, sindur a sliver
ratios.openers: one section colour may fill the page; the lal paar still closes it
ratios.quiet: paper and ink only, one sindur mark; every loud spread is followed by a quiet or dense one

roles.mark: masthead, big numbers, years, the word box; never a sentence
roles.display: headlines, pull quotes, subheads; italic carries the other language's line
roles.text: body, decks (weight 300), captions, labels (weight 600, caps, tracked), data
roles.young: only the youngest readers' pages and activity boxes

bilingual.split: English carries the reading, Bengali carries the heart: about 85 words in 100 are English. A reader with no Bengali misses nothing they need.
always: each section's name in Bengali beside the English eyebrow
bilingual.oncePerStory: one Bengali line (an epigraph, a pull quote from a Bengali source, or a closing line) with its English beneath in italic
bilingual.wordBox: one Bengali word per feature (শব্দ) that names the idea better than English: the word in Galada, how it sounds, what it means
bilingual.shaping: Bengali is shaped by HarfBuzz and drawn as outlines; Affinity cannot shape it

house.folio: foot of every page, outer corner: Bengali numerals, then 'Ochin · issue title' in Anek Bangla 7.5 pt
house.kicker: label caps in sindur, tracked, with the section's Bengali name beside it
house.matra: every headline hangs from a kajol matra rule (1.1 mm), or shankha on a dark ground

lalpaar.label: Lal paar
lalpaar.means: the red border of the Puja sari: a threshold, you are entering or leaving
lalpaar.params: solid sindur, ink shankha, tstyle 0 single thread | 1 double | 2 thread and dots, toff mm from top

matra.label: Matra rule
matra.means: the headstroke Bengali letters hang from; makes an English headline look Bengali-born
matra.params: solid kajol (shankha on dark), rule mm thickness, rstyle 0 single | 1 with hairline | 2 end beads

kantha.label: Kantha stitch
kantha.means: old cloth stitched into new: knowledge made of joined pieces
kantha.params: pts: the path it runs along (page mm), ink colour, weight pt, ends mm (knot radius, 0 none), endcol, thread 1 for double
kantha.rule: only where something connects to something; never a border for its own sake

alpana.label: Alpana
alpana.means: rice-paste welcome at the door; order found in nature
alpana.params: solid colour, apet 1 six | 2 eight | 3 ten | 4 twelve | 5 sixteen petals, aform 1 leaf | 2 lotus | 3 drop | 4 spear, aring 1 dots | 2 none | 3 double dots, ainner 1 none | 2 dots | 3 small petals

bird.label: The bird
bird.means: the question itself; any colour, may perch or look back; never drawn inside a cage
bird.params: body, wing, beak, eye, pupil, wstitch colours; flip 1 looks left; perch 1 stands on a line, pcol its colour

panel.label: Panel
panel.means: a patch of cloth or a pat scroll; its edge says where you are
panel.params: pfill colour, profile 0 plain | 1 wave (water) | 2 scallop (petals) | 3 zigzag (mountains, stitch) | 4 steps (ghats, buildings), depth mm, pitch mm, fadeL/fadeR/fadeT/fadeB mm, gcol colour to grade into, gang degrees

ornament.label: Festival ornament
ornament.means: generated alpona, kolam, rosette, border band: for ritual, craft and pattern topics
ornament.params: kind alpona | kolam | rosette | band, solid and ink colours, seed

finish.note: wobble, watercolour, wear, grain and paper on every drawn shape; type stays sharp; seeded so any shape rebuilds exactly

pictures.photographs: real, credited, public domain or open licence, source and licence recorded; crops are part of the story; never recoloured into the palette
pictures.illustration: opaque gouache, flat colour, visible brush, warm paper showing through, in the brand's colours; a world topic keeps its own art inside Ochin's frame
pictures.figures: anything exact (a scale, a curve, a wavelength) is drawn as vectors to real data, never generated; no invented portraits

imageStyle.style: opaque gouache illustration, flat colour areas with visible brush strokes, warm cream paper showing through, limited palette of turmeric yellow, deep indigo, banana-leaf green, river teal, water-lily pink, terracotta and vermilion with kohl-black lines, Bengali folk-painting warmth
imageStyle.negative: text, letters, photograph, 3d render, gold, neon, gradient background, glossy

devices: one picture or object spans both pages, so the gutter becomes part of it
an alpana ring holds a close crop of a detail the reader would miss
layers pulled apart and labelled, so a hidden structure becomes visible
frames in sequence across the spread; time reads left to right
one huge figure in Galada, the story told beside it
dates threaded on a running stitch, each knot a moment
photographs held by four photo corners on paper
two pages argue: same grid, opposite grounds
drawn to real data by code, log scale when the range demands it
voice: An elder sibling at the window: curious, warm, exact. Simple enough for a ten-year-old, layered enough that an adult keeps finding more. Asks before it tells, names real people, admits what nobody knows yet. Never 'Discover the amazing world of...'.
